not_caught_by_design.why: Not on-chain; the earn-out prices it in

Sybil payers on aged, fresh or exchange-funded accounts

not_caught_by_design.not_caught: A hidden full-access key used directly by a buyer who skipped the scan
not_caught_by_design.why: The contract cannot list its own keys; the SDK and MCP never skip the scan; a hidden key calling the contract freezes it (A23)
